mapper.insert: insert into batch.calendar_dependency_wait ( tenant_id, calendar_code, biz_date, wait_status, blocked_reason, first_waiting_at, last_checked_at, attempt_count, cutoff_at, sla_deadline_at, timezone_snapshot, dst_policy_snapshot, dependency_snapshot ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{calendarCode}, #{bizDate}, 'WAITING', #{blockedReason}, #{firstWaitingAt}, #{lastCheckedAt}, 1, #{cutoffAt}, #{slaDeadlineAt}, #{timezoneSnapshot}, #{dstPolicySnapshot}, #{dependencySnapshot}::jsonb ) on conflict (tenant_id, calendar_code, biz_date) do update set blocked_reason = excluded.blocked_reason, last_checked_at = excluded.last_checked_at, attempt_count = batch.calendar_dependency_wait.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where batch.calendar_dependency_wait.wait_status = 'WAITING'
mapper.update: update batch.calendar_dependency_wait set blocked_reason = #{blockedReason}, last_checked_at = #{checkedAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and wait_status = 'WAITING'
update batch.calendar_dependency_wait set wait_status = #{waitStatus}, opened_at = #{openedAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and wait_status = 'WAITING'

update batch.calendar_dependency_wait set timeout_alerted_at = #{alertedAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and wait_status = 'WAITING' and timeout_alerted_at is null

update batch.calendar_dependency_wait set manual_action = #{manualAction}, manual_operator_id = #{operatorId}, manual_reason = #{reason}, manual_requested_at = #{requestedAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and wait_status = 'WAITING' and manual_action is null
